scope: Immediate ignored-result file removal in actual full-Save operation Open and object refresh
implemented: Real full-Save profile enables immediate native removal before operation Open and during Save. Legacy recording flags preserve deferred behavior.
Object refresh probes actual filesystem, removes immediately, then removes row irrespective of DeleteFileW success; no queued retry.
Stale Restart deletion occurs after its single explicit exists probe and before restart/setup decisions; ignored failure continues loading.
Ordinary drive-absolute UTF16 paths below MAX_PATH use DeleteFileW without CRT probe or long-path extension. Adapter alias guard executes before deletion.
Unresolved prior deferred write to same path stays guarded; successful native removal erases stale overlay. Denial retains file.
tests: immediate file removal before row mutation
denied deletion still drops unused row
adapter alias preserves file and row
stale Restart success/denial both continue load
qualifications: No fresh original execution. Native QFile custom file engines/resource/UNC/extended/long paths remain guarded.
This closes the file syscall/row-prefix order, not full original QObject item destructor/receiver effects.
Equipment removal/copy has separate unresolved manager/fallback behavior.
Ordinary OS races and asynchronous external modifications are not controlled by these tests.
